messages.text: Hi, I returned the glass kettle. Will the shipping I paid be refunded too, or just the kettle?

The kettle is recorded as received back, so it can be considered for a refund (refund-policy/v2/return). Shipping isn’t refunded automatically; it requires a staff review (refund-policy/v2/shipping). Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?
